AI Integration Partner Needed I’m rolling out a service that embeds practical AI inside client companies, and the first metric I want to move is sales—specifically finding and converting new leads. The system must be able to hunt for prospects, qualify them, book meetings, then keep the conversation warm with automated follow-ups.

At the same time, I’d like the very same intelligence to handle day-to-day support on every channel my clients use: website chat, email inboxes, social media DMs, and even phone calls routed through Twilio or a similar voice API. A single knowledge base should power consistent answers everywhere.

Your job is to audit current workflows, recommend the right blend of models (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, etc.), APIs, and low-code connectors, then build, test, and deploy. Tight CRM syncing—HubSpot, Zoho, or Salesforce depending on the client—is non-negotiable so every captured lead is scored and tracked automatically.

Deliverables  
• Solution blueprint with data flow, tooling choices, and security notes  
• Live integrations for lead discovery, qualification, meeting scheduling, and follow-up  
• Multichannel support bots running on chat, email, social, and phone  
• Internal dashboard plus concise training docs so my team can adjust prompts and monitor KPIs  

I’ll supply access to the client CRMs, support platforms, and email domains; you bring prompt-engineering skills, API mastery, and a focus on measurable results. If this end-to-end build is in your wheelhouse, share a quick note on similar projects and the stack you prefer so we can kick off a short proof of concept and scale from there. fixed-price

Experience Level: Experienced Salesforce professional
Training Format: Online, one-on-one sessions

Project Overview

I'm looking for an experienced Salesforce professional who can provide personalized, one-on-one online training.

I'm currently learning Salesforce while working on a Salesforce cleanup project at my company. I want to build my technical knowledge and practical skills so I can use Salesforce properly, understand best practices, and contribute useful recommendations and improvements to our existing processes.

I'm looking for someone who can teach me step by step, explain concepts clearly, and use practical examples rather than just provide theoretical training.

Understanding Salesforce navigation, features, and core functionality.

Understanding data cleanup, duplicate records, and data quality best practices.

Learning how to use reports and dashboards effectively.

Understanding Salesforce objects, fields, records, and relationships.

Identifying opportunities to improve existing Salesforce processes.

Learning best practices for maintaining accurate and consistent CRM data.

Understanding the risks and considerations before making changes to Salesforce data.

Applying what I learn to my ongoing work project.

The training topics can be adjusted based on my current knowledge and the requirements of my project.

Has hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator, Consultant, or Developer.

Has practical experience with Salesforce data management, cleanup, and CRM optimization.

Can explain technical concepts in a beginner-friendly way.

Has experience providing one-on-one training or mentoring.

Can walk me through real-world examples and practical exercises.

Is patient, approachable, and willing to answer questions.

Can recommend best practices based on actual business scenarios.

Salesforce certifications and previous training experience are a plus.

Please note that any work-related examples must respect my company's confidentiality policies. Training will use sanitized examples or an approved test environment where appropriate.
